create_impaint_batch_function: create a function that copies pixel values from source coordinates to destination coordinates in a 4D batch tensor
create_resample_tex_function: create a function that resamples a texture tensor using UV coordinates and blends with original using weights
review_SeamSampler_forward: review the SeamSampler forward method that chains impaint and resample operations on a texture tensor
